name: PWL Integración Fintoc
author: PluginLatam

sections.description:
This plugin is developed independently by PluginLATAM and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Fintoc. It uses Fintoc’s public APIs as described in the Fintoc documentation.

Vendor: PluginLATAM. Pro edition (plans & trial): PWL Integración Fintoc Pro.

PWL Integración Fintoc connects WooCommerce to Fintoc checkout sessions: customers pay on Fintoc-hosted pages, then return to your store.

  • Set up in 3 minutes: an assistant verifies your secret key, creates the webhook in your Fintoc account through the API (URL, events and signing secret, nothing to copy by hand) and runs a guided test payment.
  • Direct deposit to your Chilean recipient account (RUT, account number, institution).
  • Test and live API keys.
  • Webhooks included: orders are confirmed even if the customer never returns to your store. Every event is double-checked against the Fintoc API before an order changes, so no webhook secret is required (an optional signing secret adds signature verification).
  • Refunds from WooCommerce: full or partial, reconciled automatically when Fintoc confirms or rejects them. Refunds made in the Fintoc dashboard are recorded in WooCommerce too.
  • Safe with slow transfers: an order whose payment is still being validated stays On hold with its stock reserved instead of being cancelled; if the payment fails, the stock is returned.
  • Never lose a payment: if a webhook does not arrive, the plugin checks Fintoc in the background for up to 2 days.
  • No double processing: simultaneous events for the same order are serialized, late events never move a paid order backwards, and a second payment for an already-paid order alerts the store admin by email.
  • Interface in Spanish (Chile) and English. Classic and block checkout. HPOS compatible.
  • Pro: abandoned payment rescue (customers who leave Fintoc without paying get one email with a link to pay the same order; the dashboard shows how much was recovered), separate Fintoc (card) gateway, Fintoc transaction panel on each order with “Refresh from Fintoc”, webhook event log, payment summary on the customer order page, richer transaction metadata and support from PluginLATAM.

External services

This plugin connects to the Fintoc API at https://api.fintoc.com over HTTPS to create and retrieve checkout sessions, read payment state, retrieve payment intents when staff use “Refresh from Fintoc” on an order, and perform refunds where supported. Integration behavior follows Fintoc’s official documentation. The plugin also exposes a WordPress REST URL where Fintoc’s servers send webhook events; each event is verified by reading the referenced object back from the Fintoc API (and, optionally, by its signature).

Data sent to Fintoc: Your configured secret API key is sent in the Authorization header. JSON request and response bodies may include checkout session IDs, payment intent identifiers, amounts, currency, recipient/bank details you configure, and metadata needed to link payments to WooCommerce orders.

When: During checkout, when the customer lands on the thank-you page, when Fintoc delivers a webhook event (to read the referenced payment, session or refund), in background checks for orders still waiting for a payment result (up to 2 days), before WooCommerce cancels an unpaid order, when processing refunds from WooCommerce, when staff refresh a payment from the order screen (Pro), and when an administrator uses the setup assistant (to verify the key by listing webhook endpoints and to create the webhook endpoint for this site).

Fintoc legal pages (no affiliate links; use current URLs from fintoc.com if these change):

  • Fintoc documentation (API and guides)
  • Chile — Terms: https://fintoc.com/cl/legal/terminos-y-condiciones
  • Chile — Terms (developer section tab): https://fintoc.com/cl/legal/terminos-y-condiciones?tab=user-priv
  • Mexico — Terms: https://fintoc.com/mx/legal/terminos-y-condiciones

Source Code

This plugin includes minified JavaScript and CSS under assets/. The corresponding source code lives in resources/ and is built with Vite, npm, and Tailwind CSS.

To rebuild from source:

  1. npm install
  2. npm run build
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the plugin ZIP or install from this package.
  3. Activate PWL Integración Fintoc.
  4. Go to PWL Fintoc → Settings: paste your Fintoc secret key (test or live) and save, then follow the Set up in 3 minutes assistant (verify key, connect webhook, test payment).
  5. Enable the Fintoc payment method under WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
sections.faq:
Is this an official Fintoc plugin?

No. PluginLATAM built this integration using Fintoc’s public API. “Fintoc” is a trademark of its respective owner.

Which currencies are supported?

CLP and MXN, per Fintoc availability.

Where do I configure webhooks?

Use Connect webhook automatically in the Set up in 3 minutes assistant (PWL Fintoc → Settings): it creates the endpoint in your Fintoc account for the active mode and stores its signing secret. Your site must be public and use HTTPS. To do it by hand, create an endpoint with the URL shown under Webhooks, in the same test or live mode as your API key, subscribed to the checkout_session, payment_intent and refund events.

How is the webhook endpoint secured?

The REST route accepts POST requests from Fintoc without a logged-in WordPress user. The request body is only used to locate the payment: its real state is always read again from the Fintoc API with your secret key before any order changes, so a forged request cannot mark an order as paid. If you also paste the signing secret from the Fintoc Dashboard, the Fintoc-Signature header is verified and unsigned requests receive HTTP 400.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fix: Spanish texts added in recent versions showed in English when an older translation from translate.wordpress.org was installed; the bundled es_CL catalog now fills them in.
  • Fix: secondary buttons in the setup assistant had no border and looked like plain text.
  • Fix: the setup assistant only shows “Receiving events” for events from the last 7 days.

1.1.0

  • Fix (important): payments could not start with the current Fintoc API (“Invalid string customer”). Buyer details are now sent as customer_data. Please update.
  • New: webhooks in the free edition. Orders are confirmed even when the customer does not return to the store. Each event is verified against the Fintoc API; the signing secret is now optional.
  • New: refunds from the WooCommerce order screen in the free edition, reconciled with refund.* events. A failed refund alerts the store admin; refunds made in the Fintoc dashboard are recorded in WooCommerce.
  • New: background checks (up to 2 days) for orders still waiting for a payment result, in case a webhook is lost.
  • Fix: an order whose transfer is still being validated is no longer cancelled by WooCommerce’s hold-stock cleanup; its stock stays reserved and is returned if the payment fails.
  • Fix: simultaneous events for the same order can no longer confirm it twice (stock, notes, emails); late events no longer move a paid order backwards; events from an earlier payment attempt no longer fail the current one.
  • New: a second successful payment on an already-paid order adds a note and emails the store admin.
  • Developer: requests declare the Fintoc API version (Fintoc-Version 2026-02-01). Requires WordPress 6.2+.
  • New: “Set up in 3 minutes” assistant: verifies the secret key, creates the webhook endpoint in Fintoc through the API (with its signing secret, stored per test/live mode) and creates a guided test payment order that never issues a tax document.
  • Pro: abandoned payment rescue. One email, after 30 min to 24 h, with a link to pay the same order; Fintoc is checked first so customers who already paid or whose transfer is being validated are never contacted. Recovered sales are shown on the dashboard.
  • Pro: focuses on the card gateway, order transaction panel, webhook event log, payment rescue and support.

1.0.6

  • New: optional Fintoc Smart Checkout gateway (enable it from the plugin settings if Smart Checkout is active on your Fintoc account); Fintoc shows all payment methods enabled for your account. Supports the block checkout.
  • Pro: automatic updates from PluginLATAM. While the license is active, WordPress shows the regular “Update now” button for new Pro versions.
  • Pro: license validation points to the license server directly again (avoids a redirect that broke validation requests).
  • Pro: fixed a fatal error when Fintoc Pro and another PluginLATAM Pro plugin (e.g. Bsale DTE Pro) are active on the same site.
  • Build: the free (WordPress.org) edition ships without the license client and without any external update code.
  • Compatibility: tested up to WordPress 7.1.

1.0.5

  • Developer: plugin and author URLs now use pluginlatam.cl (WordPress.org trademark compliance).
  • Developer: visible vendor branding unified as PluginLATAM.

1.0.4

  • Security: added nonce verification to cancel return handler.
  • Security: implemented late escaping for admin HTML output via wp_kses().
  • Developer: removed load_plugin_textdomain() (rely on translate.wordpress.org).
  • Developer: full prefix migration to pwlfintoc_* / PWLI_FINTOC_* for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Developer: added source code section and contributor to readme.
  • Fix: stable tag now matches plugin header version.

1.0.2

  • Admin: Overview dashboard (KPIs, recent payment intents via Fintoc API, Pro webhook preview); plugin settings moved to a Settings submenu; compact layout.
  • i18n: Spanish (Chile) strings for the new dashboard and menu labels.
  • Developer: Client::list_payment_intents() for GET /v1/payment_intents (used on the dashboard; cached).

1.0.1

  • Developer: extension hooks use the prefix pwlintegracionfintoc_* (lowercased PHP namespace; matches WordPress.org Plugin Check prefix scanner).
  • Developer: added phpcs.xml.dist (ValidHookName + PrefixAllGlobals); run PHPCS with WPCS locally (coding-standard packages are not shipped in vendor/).

1.0.0

  • Initial release: WooCommerce gateway, Lite return-path confirmation, Pro webhooks and refunds.
  • Pro: transaction snapshot and order metabox, refresh payment intent from admin, customer order summary, expanded webhook types (session expired, more payment_intent states, payout/transfer notes when correlatable).
  • Developer: extension hooks use the prefix pwlintegracionfintoc_*.

short_description: Fintoc payments for WooCommerce (CLP/MXN) with webhooks, refunds and safe handling of slow transfers, in Spanish.
